title: Generic file FD cursor continuation
goal: Implement and prove a narrow generic resource-graph continuation class for target-native regular-file file-descriptor cursors on the same Machinen Debian base, preserving bespoke envelope priority and fail-closed refusal semantics without claiming arbitrary process restore or any-binary support.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove generic capture records open regular-file fd descriptors with fd number, resolved path, access mode/flags, current offset, dev/inode identity, and stability evidence such as size/mtime/hash where required.
proofChecklist.evidence: Focused runtime/CLI tests and current local matrix prove capture records regular-file fd cursor descriptors. MoveGenericResourceGraphState regularFiles include fd, path, access, flags, offset, cursor policy, and identity dev/inode/size/mtimeEpochSeconds/sha256. Generic procfs preflight emits FILE_IDENTITY with dev/inode/size/mtime/hash. currentEvidence.summary: Inspected existing generic resource graph code and matrix rows. Existing runtime state has regularFiles with fd/path/access/flags/offset and fileOffsets, but identity only includes size+sha256 and no dev/inode/mtime. CLI preflight emits FILE_IDENTITY fd/path/size/sha256 only. Classifier currently marks all non-device regular files as read-only supported and only refuses /dev non-null devices. Loader preflights file existence/size/sha256 but does not pre-open fds or seek offsets before launch. Existing matrix rows cover generic-file-backed-worker, generic-readonly-file-cli, generic-writable-log-daemon, and generic-data-dir-daemon, but not required cursor/stale/deleted/lock/mmap/inotify rows.

Implemented generic regular-file cursor descriptor/capture schema extension and focused tests. MoveGenericResourceGraphState regularFiles identity now includes dev, inode, size, mtimeEpochSeconds, sha256, and cursor policy. Generic procfs preflight now emits FILE_IDENTITY with dev/inode/size/mtime/hash. Classifier now refuses deleted regular-file fds and regular-file fds whose flags are not proven read-only. Loader preflight originally checked file dev/inode/size/mtime/sha256 before LOAD_PID; remote proof later corrected target equality to portable size+sha256 only while retaining dev/inode/mtime as capture evidence. Focused tests passed for generic graph parsing/classification/loader preflight and rendezvous descriptor fixtures.

currentEvidence.summary: Implemented target-side generic regular-file cursor reconstruction for no-pipe generic loads. Added packages/cli/src/move-generic-file-cursor-loader.ts. Generic loader now emits a Python target-native launch wrapper for accepted read-only regularFiles: it opens each captured path O_RDONLY, lseeks to the captured cursor offset, dup2s it to the captured fd number, redirects stdout/stderr to the loader log, then os.execvp()s the target argv. File identity preflights still run before launch, and health probes must pass before LOAD_PID is printed. Existing pipe launch paths remain unchanged.
